name: Scythe Blades (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

disable: DC 21 Thievery check to disable each blade.

items.name: Falling Scythes
items.text: When the trip wire is pulled or severed, both blades swing down, each one attacking all creatures under the ceiling grooves. The trap makes a melee attack with each blade with +17 to each attack roll. There's no multiple attack penalty on these attacks. On a hit, a blade deals 2d12+4 slashing damage. On a critical hit, the damage is doubled plus 6 extra damage.

text: Two blades, each hidden in a 15-foot-long ceiling groove, are both connected to a trip wire.
